def _query_pairs(query: bytes, *, require: set[str], optional: set[str] = frozenset()):
    if not query or len(query) > 4096:
        return None
    try:
        pairs = parse_qsl(
            query.decode("utf-8"),
            keep_blank_values=True,
            strict_parsing=True,
            max_num_fields=12,
        )
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
        return None
    if any(not value for _key, value in pairs):
        return None
    keys = [key for key, _value in pairs]
    if len(keys) != len(set(keys)):
        return None
    if not require.issubset(keys) or not set(keys).issubset(require | optional):
        return None
    return dict(pairs)


class Firewall:
    def __init__(
        self,
        app,
        *,
        layout: dict[str, pathlib.Path],
        report: dict[str, Any],
        host_token: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.app = app
        self.case = layout["case"]
        self.case_id = report["case_id"]
        self.task_id = report["task_id"]
        self.material_id = report["material"]["material_id"]
        self.material_name = report["material"]["name"]
        self.citation = CITATION
        self.expected_auth = ("Bearer " + host_token).encode("utf-8")
        self.registry = layout["appdata"] / "cases.json"
        self.ledger = layout["root"] / "requests.ndjson"
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.failure_code: str | None = None
        self.source_claimed = False
        self.source_complete = False
        self.case_open_attempts = 0
        self.case_open_ok = 0
        self.auth_denials = 0
        self.policy_denials: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.read_ok = 0
        with open(self.ledger, "x", encoding="utf-8"):
            pass

    def _record(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        status: int | None,
        disposition: str,
        started: float,
    ) -> None:
        item = {
            "method": method,
            "path": path,
            "status": status,
            "disposition": disposition,
            "channel": "tcp_loopback",
            "elapsed_ms": int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000),
        }
        with self.lock:
            if self.failure_code is not None:
                item["protocol_failure"] = self.failure_code
            self.records.append(item)
            _append_ndjson(self.ledger, item)

    def _deny(self, code: str) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.policy_denials[code] = self.policy_denials.get(code, 0) + 1

    def _fail(self, code: str) -> None:
        with self.lock:
            self.failure_code = self.failure_code or code

    def _authorized(self, scope) -> bool:
        values = [
            value
            for key, value in scope.get("headers", [])
            if key.lower() == b"authorization"
        ]
        if len(values) != 1 or not hmac.compare_digest(values[0], self.expected_auth):
            with self.lock:
                self.auth_denials += 1
            return False
        return True

    def _own_registry(self) -> bool:
        try:
            data = _checked_file(self.registry, 64 * 1024)
            cases = data.get("cases") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
            return (
                isinstance(data, dict)
                and data.get("v") == 1
                and isinstance(cases, list)
                and len(cases) == 1
                and cases[0].get("case_id") == self.case_id
                and _norm(cases[0].get("root", "")) == _norm(self.case)
            )
        except (Deny, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return False

    def _source_authority(self) -> bool:
        try:
            task_dir = _single_child(self.case / "工作区" / "任务")
            if task_dir.name != self.task_id:
                return False
            result = _checked_file(task_dir / "result.json")
            index = _checked_file(self.case / "工作区" / "材料" / "index.json")
            material = next(
                (
                    item
                    for item in index.get("materials", [])
                    if item.get("material_id") == self.material_id
                ),
                None,
            )
            return bool(
                result.get("task_id") == self.task_id
                and isinstance(result.get("citations"), list)
                and len(result["citations"]) == 1
                and result["citations"][0].get("material_id") == self.material_id
                and result["citations"][0].get("name") == self.material_name
                and result["citations"][0].get("loc")
                == {"unit": "line", "from": 1}
                and material is not None
                and material.get("name") == self.material_name
                and material.get("origin") == "ref"
            )
        except (Deny, OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
            return False

    def _case_query(self, path: str, query: bytes) -> str | None:
        values = _query_pairs(query, require={"case_id"})
        if values is None:
            return "CASE_QUERY_EXACT"
        if values["case_id"] != self.case_id:
            return "CASE_ID_OUTSIDE_RUN"
        return None

    def _source_query(self, query: bytes) -> str | None:
        values = _query_pairs(
            query,
            require={"case_id", "material_id", "citation", "task_id"},
        )
        if values is None:
            return "SOURCE_QUERY_EXACT"
        if values["case_id"] != self.case_id:
            return "SOURCE_CASE_ID"
        if values["material_id"] != self.material_id:
            return "SOURCE_MATERIAL_ID"
        if values["citation"] != self.citation:
            return "SOURCE_CITATION"
        if values["task_id"] != self.task_id:
            return "SOURCE_TASK_ID"
        if not self._own_registry():
            return "SOURCE_CASE_REGISTRY"
        if not self._source_authority():
            return "SOURCE_AUTHORITY"
        with self.lock:
            if self.source_claimed or self.source_complete:
                return "SOURCE_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED"
            self.source_claimed = True
        return None

    def _claim_case(self, data: Any, query: bytes) -> str | None:
        if query:
            return "CASE_OPEN_QUERY"
        if not (
            isinstance(data, dict)
            and set(data) == {"path", "template"}
            and data.get("template") is None
            and isinstance(data.get("path"), str)
        ):
            return "CASE_OPEN_BODY"
        if _norm(data["path"]) != _norm(self.case):
            return "CASE_OPEN_PATH"
        with self.lock:
            if self.case_open_attempts >= 4:
                return "CASE_OPEN_LIMIT"
            self.case_open_attempts += 1
        return None

    def _policy(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        data: Any,
        query: bytes,
    ) -> str | None:
        if (method, path) not in ROUTES:
            return "ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED"
        if not self._own_registry():
            return "CASE_REGISTRY"
        if method == "POST":
            return self._claim_case(data, query)
        if path in NO_QUERY_ROUTES:
            return None if not query else "UNEXPECTED_QUERY"
        if path == "/api/task/current":
            values = _query_pairs(query, require={"session_id"})
            if values is None:
                return "SESSION_ID_QUERY_REQUIRED"
            if len(values["session_id"]) > 128:
                return "SESSION_ID_LENGTH"
            return None
        if path in CASE_QUERY_ROUTES:
            return self._case_query(path, query)
        if path == "/api/source":
            return self._source_query(query)
        return "ROUTE_NOT_ALLOWED"

    def _complete_case(self, status: int | None, response: Any) -> None:
        value = response.get("value") if isinstance(response, dict) else None
        if not (
            status == 200
            and isinstance(response, dict)
            and set(response) == {"ok", "value"}
            and response.get("ok") is True
            and isinstance(value, dict)
            and value.get("case_id") == self.case_id
            and value.get("created") is False
        ):
            self._fail("CASE_OPEN_RESPONSE")
            return
        with self.lock:
            self.case_open_ok += 1

    def _complete_source(self, status: int | None, response: Any) -> None:
        value = response.get("value") if isinstance(response, dict) else None
        if not (
            status == 200
            and isinstance(response, dict)
            and set(response) == {"ok", "value"}
            and response.get("ok") is True
            and isinstance(value, dict)
            and value.get("name") == self.material_name
            and value.get("loc") == {"unit": "line", "from": 1}
            and value.get("text") == SOURCE_LINE
            and value.get("page_png_base64") is None
            and value.get("source_changed") is False
            and value.get("original_status") == "ok"
        ):
            self._fail("SOURCE_RESPONSE")
            return
        with self.lock:
            self.source_complete = True

    def _complete_read(self, path: str, status: int | None, response: Any) -> None:
        if path == "/health":
            if not (
                status == 200
                and response == {"status": "ok", "contract_version": "1.6"}
            ):
                self._fail("HEALTH_RESPONSE")
            return
        if not (
            status == 200
            and isinstance(response, dict)
            and set(response) == {"ok", "value"}
            and response.get("ok") is True
        ):
            self._fail("READ_RESPONSE")
            return
        with self.lock:
            self.read_ok += 1

    async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send) -> None:
        if scope["type"] != "http":
            return
        method, path, started = scope["method"], scope["path"], time.monotonic()
        if not self._authorized(scope):
            self._record(method, path, 401, "auth_not_forwarded", started)
            await _guard_reply(send, 401, "AUTH_REQUIRED")
            return
        if (method, path) not in ROUTES:
            self._deny("ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED")
            self._record(
                method, path, 403, "ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", started
            )
            await _guard_reply(send, 403, "ROUTE_OR_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED")
            return

        body, data = b"", None
        if method == "POST":
            original = receive
            try:
                body = await _read_body(receive)
            except Deny:
                self._deny("BODY_TOO_LARGE")
                self._record(method, path, 413, "BODY_TOO_LARGE", started)
                await _guard_reply(send, 413, "BODY_TOO_LARGE")
                return
            if body is None:
                self._record(method, path, None, "disconnected", started)
                return
            data = _json(body)
            used = False

            async def replay():
                nonlocal used
                if not used:
                    used = True
                    return {"type": "http.request", "body": body, "more_body": False}
                return await original()

            receive = replay

        query = scope.get("query_string", b"")
        denial = self._policy(method, path, data, query)
        if denial:
            self._deny(denial)
            self._record(method, path, 403, denial, started)
            await _guard_reply(send, 403, denial)
            return

        status: int | None = None
        captured = bytearray()
        overflow = False

        async def observed(message):
            nonlocal status, overflow
            if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
                status = int(message["status"])
            elif message["type"] == "http.response.body":
                chunk = message.get("body", b"")
                room = max(0, MAX_CAPTURE - len(captured))
                if len(chunk) > room:
                    overflow = True
                captured.extend(chunk[:room])
            await send(message)

        try:
            await self.app(scope, receive, observed)
        except BaseException as exc:
            self._fail(getattr(exc, "code", type(exc).__name__))
            raise
        finally:
            self._record(method, path, status, "native_app", started)

        if overflow:
            self._fail("RESPONSE_CAPTURE_OVERFLOW")
            return
        response = _json(bytes(captured))
        if path == "/api/case/open":
            self._complete_case(status, response)
        elif path == "/api/source":
            self._complete_source(status, response)
        else:
            self._complete_read(path, status, response)

    def snapshot(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self.lock:
            return list(self.records)

    def evidence(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self.lock:
            complete = (
                self.failure_code is None
                and self.source_claimed
                and self.source_complete
                and self.case_open_ok >= 1
            )
            return {
                "protocol_complete": complete,
                "failure_code": self.failure_code,
                "source_claimed": self.source_claimed,
                "source_complete": self.source_complete,
                "case_open_attempts": self.case_open_attempts,
                "case_open_ok": self.case_open_ok,
                "auth_denials": self.auth_denials,
                "policy_denials": dict(sorted(self.policy_denials.items())),
                "read_ok": self.read_ok,
            }

& $python (Join-Path $here 'server.py') --prepare --root $root
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'prepare refused' }

$serve = Start-Process -FilePath $python `
    -ArgumentList @((Join-Path $here 'server.py'), '--serve', '--seconds', '20', '--root', $root) `
    -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden

try {
    $limit = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(15)
    while (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'ready.json'))) {
        if ($serve.HasExited) { throw 'fixture server exited before ready' }
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $limit) { throw 'fixture server ready timeout' }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200
    }
    & $node (Join-Path $here 'probe.mjs')
    $probeExit = $LASTEXITCODE
    Wait-Process -Id $serve.Id -Timeout 35 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($probeExit -ne 0) { throw 'probe failed' }
} finally {
    if (-not $serve.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $serve.Id -Force }
}

"""case_list_materials、case_read_material（case_search 在 tools/search.py，T9）。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
from datetime import datetime

from ..case import texts
from ..errors import ApiError
from . import ToolContext

MAX_CHARS = 8000


# ---------- case_list_materials ----------

def list_materials(ctx: ToolContext, a: dict) -> dict:
    index = ctx.index()
    stale = ctx.materials.stale_ocr(ctx.root, index)
    rows = [{"material_id": m["material_id"], "name": m["name"], "type": m["type"], "status": m["status"],
             "unit": m["unit"], "unit_count": m["unit_count"], "is_ocr": m["is_ocr"],
             "stale_ocr": m["material_id"] in stale, "error": m["error"]} for m in index["materials"]]
    return {"materials": rows, "total": len(rows)}


# ---------- case_read_material ----------

def _units_of(ctx: ToolContext, m: dict) -> list[texts.Unit]:
    if m["status"] == "failed":
        raise ApiError("MATERIAL_NOT_READY", "failed")
    units = texts.split_units(texts.read_text(ctx.root, m), m["unit"])
    if not units or not texts.readable(units):
        raise ApiError("MATERIAL_NOT_READY", "needs_ocr")
    return units


TRUNC_TAIL = "\n…（本单元没读完，用 offset 接着读）"


def read_material(ctx: ToolContext, a: dict) -> dict:
    """offset（契约 1.2，N31）：单元本身超过 max_chars 时分段读同一单元，返回 next_offset；只有整个单元都读到了
    才记进 reads.json（P1-1）——分段读时按"从 0 起连续读到了第几个字"累计，读到单元末尾才算读完。"""
    if "more_names" in a:
        return _read_many(ctx, a)
    m = ctx.material_by_name(a["name"])
    units = _units_of(ctx, m)
    start = a.get("start", 1)
    offset = a.get("offset", 0)
    limit = a.get("max_chars", MAX_CHARS)
    rest = [u for u in units if u.no >= start]
    if not rest:
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "start_out_of_range")
    first = rest[0]
    nxt = next((u.no for u in rest[1:]), None)
    if offset or len(texts.render([first], m["unit"])) > limit:
        return _read_part(ctx, m, first, offset, limit, nxt)
    picked: list[texts.Unit] = []
    for u in rest:
        if picked and len(texts.render(picked + [u], m["unit"])) > limit:
            break
        picked.append(u)
    text = texts.render(picked, m["unit"])
    nxt = next((u.no for u in rest if u.no > picked[-1].no), None)
    _record(ctx, m, picked[0].no, picked[-1].no)
    return {"name": m["name"], "material_id": m["material_id"], "unit": m["unit"], "start": picked[0].no,
            "end": picked[-1].no, "text": text, "has_more": nxt is not None, "next_start": nxt, "next_offset": None}


SEP = "【材料：{name}】"


def _read_many(ctx: ToolContext, a: dict) -> dict:
    """一次读几份（契约 1.4 more_names）：name 和 more_names 各从头读，按顺序接起来，各份前面一行【材料：<材料名>】，
    合计不超过 max_chars。第一份照单份的规矩（读不了、不存在照常报错）；后面的放不下、读不了、不存在都不让整次失败，
    在 parts 里写明。只把整单元读到的记进 reads.json。"""
    if "start" in a or "offset" in a or a["name"] in a["more_names"]:
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "more_names_with_start")
    limit = a.get("max_chars", MAX_CHARS)
    first = ctx.material_by_name(a["name"])
    head = SEP.format(name=first["name"]) + "\n"
    r = read_material(ctx, {"name": a["name"], "max_chars": max(500, limit - len(head))})
    texts_out = [head + r["text"]]
    parts = [{"name": r["name"], "material_id": r["material_id"], "unit": r["unit"], "read": True, "start": r["start"],
              "end": r["end"], "has_more": r["has_more"], "next_start": r["next_start"], "error": None}]
    used = len(texts_out[0])
    for name in a["more_names"]:
        skip = {"name": name, "material_id": None, "unit": None, "read": False, "start": None, "end": None,
                "has_more": False, "next_start": None}
        try:
            m = ctx.material_by_name(name)
            units = _units_of(ctx, m)
        except ApiError as e:
            parts.append({**skip, "error": "没有这份材料" if e.code == "MATERIAL_NOT_FOUND" else "还不能读取（待识别或处理失败）"})
            continue
        skip.update(material_id=m["material_id"], unit=m["unit"])
        head = "\n\n" + SEP.format(name=m["name"]) + "\n"
        picked: list[texts.Unit] = []
        for u in units:
            if used + len(head) + len(texts.render(picked + [u], m["unit"])) > limit:
                break
            picked.append(u)
        if not picked:
            parts.append({**skip, "has_more": True, "next_start": units[0].no, "error": "放不下，请单独读这份"})
            continue
        body = head + texts.render(picked, m["unit"])
        texts_out.append(body)
        used += len(body)
        nxt = next((u.no for u in units if u.no > picked[-1].no), None)
        _record(ctx, m, picked[0].no, picked[-1].no)
        parts.append({**skip, "read": True, "start": picked[0].no, "end": picked[-1].no, "has_more": nxt is not None,
                      "next_start": nxt, "error": None})
    return {**r, "text": "".join(texts_out), "parts": parts}


def _record(ctx: ToolContext, m: dict, frm: int, to: int) -> None:
    ctx.tasks.add_read(ctx.root, ctx.task["task_id"], {
        "material_id": m["material_id"], "material_version": m["sha256"], "unit": m["unit"],
        "from": frm, "to": to, "at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")})


def _read_part(ctx: ToolContext, m: dict, u: texts.Unit, offset: int, limit: int, nxt: int | None) -> dict:
    """读一个单元的一段：[offset, offset + 能放下的字数)。"""
    if offset > len(u.text) or (offset and offset == len(u.text)):
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "offset_out_of_range")
    overhead = len(texts.render([dataclasses.replace(u, text="x")], m["unit"])) - 1  # 位置标记、表头
    if overhead + len(TRUNC_TAIL) + 1 > limit:  # 表头本身就放不下（很宽的表格）：不带列名表头（F4）
        u = dataclasses.replace(u, header="")
        overhead = len(texts.render([dataclasses.replace(u, text="x")], m["unit"])) - 1
    room = max(1, limit - overhead - len(TRUNC_TAIL))
    end = min(len(u.text), offset + room)
    text = texts.render([dataclasses.replace(u, text=u.text[offset:end])], m["unit"])
    more = end < len(u.text)
    if more:
        text += TRUNC_TAIL
    if ctx.tasks.read_part(ctx.task["task_id"], m, u.no, offset, end, len(u.text)):
        _record(ctx, m, u.no, u.no)   # 这个单元从头到尾都读到了
    return {"name": m["name"], "material_id": m["material_id"], "unit": m["unit"], "start": u.no, "end": u.no,
            "text": text, "has_more": more or nxt is not None, "next_start": u.no if more else nxt,
            "next_offset": end if more else None}

"""case_save_draft、case_suggest_wiki。"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime

from .. import checks, contracts, logs
from ..case import documents, gate
from ..case.task import IN_PROGRESS
from ..errors import ApiError
from . import ToolContext

PENDING_REL = "工作区/wiki/待确认.json"
PENDING_SCHEMA = "files/wiki_pending.schema.json"
_WIKI_LOCK = threading.Lock()  # 待确认.json 的读-改-写（P2-3）；只是本地读写，跨案件共用一把也不会久等


def _citation_check(root: str, case_id: str, task: dict, index: dict, content: str,
                    skills_dirs) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    kind = checks.skill_kind(skills_dirs, task.get("skill"))
    check, cites = checks.check_text(content, checks.MaterialSet.from_case(root, index), kind)
    logs.event("checks", "draft", case_id=case_id, duration_ms=(time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
    return check, cites


def citation_check(ctx: ToolContext, content: str) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
    """出处核对（T10）：按任务 Skill 的 kind 区分 G 类；不查 D 类（裁决 1）。日志只记元数据。"""
    return _citation_check(ctx.root, ctx.case_id, ctx.task, ctx.index(), content, ctx.skills_dirs)


def merge_citations(old: list[dict], new: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    """本任务全部草稿的出处，按（材料编号、位置）去重（裁决 6）；同一处以最新这次保存的为准
    （两次保存之间材料重新导入过，material_version 取新的；复核 NOTE）。"""
    out = {(c["material_id"], json.dumps(c["loc"], sort_keys=True)): c for c in old}
    for c in new:
        out[(c["material_id"], json.dumps(c["loc"], sort_keys=True))] = c
    return list(out.values())


def save_draft(ctx: ToolContext, a: dict) -> dict:
    title = a["title"].strip()
    if not title:
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "empty_title")
    tid = ctx.task["task_id"]
    # 取版本号、写文件、改 result.json 都在这个任务的锁里（P1-3、P2-2）；
    # 匹配已有版本不分大小写：NTFS 上 Report-v1.md 和 report-v1.md 是同一个文件
    with ctx.tasks.task_lock(tid):
        # 在任务锁里再核一次状态：/core/tool 在锁外查过，这之间 end 可能已经插进来（F2）
        task = ctx.tasks.locate(tid)[2]
        if task["state"] != "running":
            raise ApiError("TASK_NOT_FOUND", "not_running")
        return _save_locked(
            ctx.tasks, ctx.root, ctx.case_id, task, title, a["content"],
            check_fn=lambda: citation_check(ctx, a["content"]),
            coverage_fn=lambda: ctx.tasks.coverage(ctx.root, ctx.case_id, tid),
        )


def _save_locked(tasks, root: str, case_id: str, task: dict, title: str, content: str,
                 *, check_fn, coverage_fn) -> dict:
    """调用方持有来源任务锁；只写一个新版本，并在 metadata 失败时收回本次新文件。"""
    tid = task["task_id"]
    drafts_rel = tasks.rel(tid, "草稿")
    version = tasks.next_draft_version(root, title, ".md")   # 本案同标题接着往上加，不分任务
    rel = f"{drafts_rel}/{title}-v{version}.md"
    target = gate.resolve_write(root, rel, op="save_draft")
    if target.exists():
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "target_exists")
    gate.write_bytes(root, rel, content.encode("utf-8"), op="save_draft")  # 标题是设备名等：闸门拒绝
    try:
        check, cites = check_fn()
        cov = coverage_fn()
        res = tasks.result(root, tid)
        res["drafts"].append({"title": title, "path": rel, "version": version})
        res.update(citation_check=check, coverage=cov, citations=merge_citations(res["citations"], cites))
        tasks.save_result(root, res)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            gate.delete_work_file(root, rel, op="save_draft_rollback")
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 保留原异常；清理失败只记类型
            logs.event("draft", "rollback", status="fail", case_id=case_id, error=type(exc).__name__)
        raise
    # 正式草稿存好了：进度文件清掉（T14 派修；之后模型再回复，progress 会重写，task/end 时再清）
    gate.delete_work_file(root, f"{drafts_rel}/{IN_PROGRESS}", op="save_draft")
    not_fully = [p["name"] for p in cov["partially_read"]] + cov["not_read"]
    return {"path": rel, "version": version, "citation_check": check, "coverage": cov, "not_fully_read": not_fully}


def save_document_ui(tasks, materials, skills_dirs, a: dict) -> dict:
    """界面保存：来源任务结束后，从登记恢复标题并写同标题新草稿版本。"""
    source = documents.locate_source(tasks, a["case_id"], a["path"])
    if contracts.errors("tools/case_save_draft.schema.json", "#/$defs/args",
                        {"title": source["title"], "content": a["content"]}):
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "source_metadata")
    tid = source["task_id"]
    with tasks.task_lock(tid):
        root, task = documents.recheck_stable_source(tasks, source)
        saved = _save_locked(
            tasks, root, a["case_id"], task, source["title"], a["content"],
            check_fn=lambda: _citation_check(
                root, a["case_id"], task, tasks.index_for_task(task), a["content"], skills_dirs),
            coverage_fn=lambda: tasks.coverage(root, a["case_id"], tid),
        )
    return {"task_id": tid, **saved}


def suggest_wiki(ctx: ToolContext, a: dict) -> dict:
    with _WIKI_LOCK:
        return _suggest_wiki(ctx, a)


def _suggest_wiki(ctx: ToolContext, a: dict) -> dict:
    p = gate.resolve_internal(ctx.root, PENDING_REL, op="suggest_wiki")
    data = contracts.read_json(p) if p.is_file() else {"v": 1, "suggestions": []}
    contracts.validate(PENDING_SCHEMA, "", data)
    n = max((int(s["id"][1:]) for s in data["suggestions"]), default=0) + 1
    if n > 9999:
        raise ApiError("INVALID_ARGUMENT", "too_many_suggestions")
    sid = f"S{n:04d}"
    data["suggestions"].append({"id": sid, "field": a["field"], "value": a["value"], "source": a["source"],
                                "reason": a.get("reason"), "task_id": ctx.task["task_id"],
                                "created_at": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                                "status": "pending"})
    contracts.validate(PENDING_SCHEMA, "", data)
    gate.write_bytes(ctx.root, PENDING_REL, json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode("utf-8"),
                     op="suggest_wiki")
    return {"suggestion_id": sid}
